latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of talking-circle: animate circular avatar videos from audio and frame images.

- Create Telegram-style talking-circle (round) video messages from four avatar images and audio, with lip-sync and blink.
- Supports audio-to-video and text-to-video workflows.
- Text-to-video mode supports ElevenLabs or SaluteSpeech (Sber) TTS; also works with audio from any TTS engine.
- Detailed instructions for frame preparation, TTS setup, and usage examples provided.
- No API key needed if providing your own audio file.
